classes.name: tiles
classes.reason: tiles are read by the separate _prefetch process feeding a bounded queue while the main loop computes (probe.sleep_seconds(compute_s)), so the read is overlapped rather than waited on, and each tile file is read once via read_staged.

classes.name: masks
classes.reason: each iteration calls probe.read_staged on the mask file inline and times it as gated stall before the compute sleep, so the calling rank stalls on that single read of each mask file with no other ranks held at a barrier.
